gloss: business day; working day; day of operation

definitions.gloss: business day; working day; day of operation
definitions.explanation: A day on which a business, office, or institution is open and operating. Used in commerce, banking, and service industries to distinguish from holidays and days off.

examples.japanese: {営業日|えいぎょうび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{月曜|げつよう}→月曜：30298_getsuyou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{金曜|きんよう}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧です。
examples.english: Business days are Monday through Friday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{発送|はっそう}→発送：10458_hassou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{翌|よく}{営業日|えいぎょうび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Shipping will be on the next business day.

examples.japanese: お⟦{届|とど}け→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧3{営業日|えいぎょうび}ほど⟦かかります→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。

⟦{年末年始|ねんまつねんし}→年末年始：12457_nenmatsunenshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{営業日|えいぎょうび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ございます→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: Business days may change during the year-end and New Year period.

notes:
Extremely common in commercial and administrative contexts. Appears constantly on websites, store signs, and official notices. Distinguished from 定休日 (regular day off) and 休業日 (closed day).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {翌|よく}{営業日|えいぎょうび}: next business day
- ○{営業日|えいぎょうび}⟦{以内|いない}→以内：01317_inai⟧: within ○ business days
- {営業日|えいぎょうび}⟦カレンダー→カレンダー：02897_karendaa⟧: business day calendar
- {営業日|えいぎょうび}⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧: change in business days

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{平日|へいじつ}→平日：03033_heijitsu⟧: weekday — calendar-based (Mon-Fri), not business-specific
- ⟦{定休日|ていきゅうび}→定休日：09541_teikyuubi⟧: regular day off — the scheduled closing day of a business
- ⟦{休業日|きゅうぎょうび}→休業日：21152_kyuugyoubi⟧: closed day — a day when business is suspended
